description:

An opportunity to acquire a Periodic Accommodation Right (timesharing), giving you the right to use a T0 studio apartment for 10 specific weeks each year, within a tourist development in Albufeira.
Enjoy your own place in the Algarve for 10 weeks every year — whether for your own holidays, to share with family and friends, or to let others use the weeks, subject to the applicable terms and conditions.
A flexible opportunity that combines lifestyle, leisure and rental potential, allowing you to make the most of your allocated weeks throughout the year, either for your own enjoyment or by making them available to others.
The right also includes access to the development's communal areas and services, offering a comfortable and enjoyable holiday experience in the Algarve.
A great way to enjoy the Algarve, year after year.
